native_mechanism_note: Pure concat (duration 0, no xfade); whoosh sting overlaid by apply-effects-between-clips.py.
description: Frame-perfect hard cut between clips with a warm whoosh sting layered across the seam. Default workhorse for energetic scene changes in short-form horror — preserves retention pacing while masking the cut audibly.

ffmpeg_params.whoosh_start_ms: Place whoosh peak at the cut. Set = (duration(clip_a) * 1000) - 80 (whoosh attack lands ~80ms before cut; 0.48s sting tails into clip_b).

audio_recipe: whoosh-warm.mp3 (0.48s) at volume 0.55, peak placed ~80ms before the cut seam so attack feels causal. No fade — relies on natural whoosh decay.
use_cases: Scene change between narrative beats with energy bump
H1→H2, H2→H3 transitions in horror-choice format
Cut from wide → close-up with emotional escalation
Default cut for cuts/min target 2-7 (canonical band)
avoid_for: Inside a single emotional moment (use cross-fade-0.5s)
hyperframes_alternative: Schedule whoosh-warm.mp3 audio track at scene-change t with volume 0.55. Hard cut happens naturally via .scene-image opacity switch on next data-start.
canonical_observations: DOMINANT inter-clip pattern in 8/8 F1 refs. Hard cuts confirmed quantitatively: ref-03 (42 cuts, descriptive § 6 '95% hard cuts'), ref-06 (17 hard cuts), ref-08 (18 hard cuts, 'Hard cut a fade negro post-muerte'), ref-09 (34 hard cuts — highest cut density), ref-10 (22 hard cuts), ref-11 (22 hard cuts), ref-12 (32 hard cuts), ref-13 (68 hard cuts, CUTS FLOODING at climaxes). Audio-impact-sync evidence supporting whoosh sting: ref-11 descriptive § 7 '4 momentos donde un impacto de audio coincide con un flash de luz o cambio de texto', ref-08 § 7 audio-visual sync at decarga eléctrica, ref-10 § 7 'SFX de escape de vapor sincronizado con efecto visual', ref-13 § 7 'impacto sónico sincronizado'. Whoosh-specific sting NOT explicitly named in refs (refs use generic 'impacto de audio') but functional pattern (hard cut + audio sting) is 8/8 universal.
validated_notes: 8/8 explicit F1 canonical hard-cut prevalence. Workhorse cut for horror-choice. Whoosh sting at 0.55 volume aligns with hard rule #9. The 'whoosh-warm.mp3' specific timbre is engineering choice — canonical refs use varied impact stings (drone bursts, flash SFX, drop hits), all functioning as audio masking for cut seam.
